title: Unauth Socket.IO get_stream IDOR (url_key)
summary: Prove anonymous get_stream returns a stream namespace for a fabricated siteId. Do not fetch video. Do not crash the Node process.
steps: POST Engine.IO packet 42["get_stream", {siteId: fabricated, userId: ATTACKER, userType: Anonymous}].
PASS if a url_key / namespace is returned without a session. Repeat 1–2 other siteIds.
Do not fetch the video stream. Do not send null or malformed crash loops (ICS availability).
Then canary Origin on /socket.io/ (queue cors_credentials) and quote hardcoded siteId/userType=Admin from page JS (queue js_secrets).
pass_signals: Anonymous get_stream returns url_key for a fabricated siteId
kill_signals: Upgrade/event requires auth; get_stream 401/403; no url_key
